label: Mató
note: Made from heat-treated milk, set with rennet, cardoon or lemon, not from whey, so unlike ricotta

about.text: A fresh Catalan cheese of cow's or goat's milk, set with a little rennet or acid and drained in a mould; mild, soft and eaten with honey.

how.text: Mató is the Catalan fresh cheese. The milk is heated far hotter than for other cheeses, which keeps the whey proteins in the curd and makes it rich and moist, then set with rennet, cardoon, calcium chloride or acid, and the curd is drained in a cloth or basket without pressing. It is neither salted nor fermented.

steps.note: Far above normal cheese-milk heating, so the whey proteins stay in the curd.
Animal rennet (most common) or cardoon thistle extract; calcium chloride flocculation industrially; lemon juice or other organic acid (pH about 4.6) at home.
